rows.description: A manager notices that slogans about growth do not help when there is no time, feedback or safety to learn; mindset works best in environments that make learning possible.

rows.subtype: Feeling like a fraud in a top college [Actor]
rows.description: A student admitted to a prestigious institute believes they got in by luck and that everyone will soon find out; success is discounted while comparison with others is harsh.

rows.subtype: Working overly hard to avoid exposure [Actor]
rows.description: A new employee stays late and over-prepares because they fear being seen as unqualified; the cycle of effort and relief keeps the belief alive since success is credited to overwork.

rows.description: A team member notices a quietly accomplished colleague never speaks in meetings and turns down promotions; the observer says specifically what value the person brings.
